source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 按截图峰位与多峰形态估计的混合高斯示例轮廓；不是原始流式数据
provenance.en: Gaussian-mixture demonstration curves approximating visible modes; not FCS events.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 原始 FCS 文件或每个 event 的 marker 强度、样本 ID、细胞群和刺激 −/+ 条件。
补偿矩阵、门控层级、活细胞/双细胞排除及 marker 对应通道。
对数/logicle/arcsinh 变换及参数、阴性对照和密度归一化方法。
en: Original FCS files or per-event marker intensities, sample IDs, cell populations and −/+ stimulation condition.
Compensation matrix, gating hierarchy, live-cell/doublet filters and marker-to-channel mapping.
Log/logicle/arcsinh transformation and parameters, negative controls and density normalization.

preprocessing.zh: 先完成补偿、门控与表达变换，再提供 marker/group/condition/value；也可提供 x/density。横轴上的 10 的幂标签假定输入已在对应对数坐标。
preprocessing.en: Compensate, gate and transform expression upstream, then supply marker/group/condition/value or x/density. Power-of-ten ticks assume the input is already in the corresponding logarithmic coordinates.

description.zh: 通道对应的 marker 名称
description.en: Marker corresponding to the measurement channel

description.zh: 实验组或细胞群；与样式一致
description.en: Experimental group or cell population; match style

description.en: Transformed x coordinate, not a raw feature matrix
